scripts.dev: npm run build -w @vichaar/shared && npm run build -w @vichaar/agents && concurrently -k -n web,api "npm run dev -w @vichaar/web" "npm run dev -w @vichaar/api"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @vichaar/shared && npm run build -w @vichaar/agents && npm run build -w @vichaar/database && npm run build -w @vichaar/validation && npm run build -w @vichaar/api && npm run build -w @vichaar/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @vichaar/shared && npm run build -w @vichaar/agents && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
